title: DiffCkt: A Diffusion Model-Based Hybrid Neural Network Framework for Automatic Transistor-Level Generation of Analog Circuits
problem: Analog circuit pre-layout design heavily depends on manual design by experienced engineers, limiting automation and scalability across diverse application scenarios.
motivation: Automating analog circuit design can reduce development time and enable rapid exploration of design variants for specific performance requirements.
method: Diffusion model-based hybrid neural network framework that directly generates transistor-level circuit structures and device parameters tailored to performance requirements; introduces Circuit Generation Efficiency Index (CGEI) metric combining figure of merit and generation time.
key_novelty: Using diffusion models for end-to-end automated transistor-level analog circuit topology and parameter generation.
contributions: Diffusion model-based framework for circuit structure and parameter generation
Circuit Generation Efficiency Index (CGEI) metric for generation quality assessment
Automated pre-layout design flow achieving state-of-the-art efficiency
limitations: Pre-layout phase only; full design flow validation including layout effects and post-silicon verification not addressed.
